title: Taking a GenAI Assistant to Production on Amazon Bedrock: Knowledge Base, Fine-Tuning and Release Gates for Irish Healthcare
excerpt: For an Irish health guidance assistant on Amazon Bedrock, published HIQA and HSE guidance goes into a Knowledge Base in eu-west-1, fine-tuning is kept for behaviour on non-personal data because Nova customisation runs in US Regions, and IHI and PPSN values are blocked by a dataset gate and a Guardrail. A Step Functions release pipeline promotes a change only after a golden-set evaluation and clinical sign-off.
